overnight.mechanism: Hold from the closing auction to the next opening auction. The equity premium accrues mostly overnight (risk borne while markets are shut; retail buying at the open and institutional selling during the day).

intraday.mechanism: Hold (or short) from the opening auction to the closing auction: the mirror of the overnight leg.

weekday_overnight.mechanism: Overnight hold only into one weekday (the weekend effect and its relatives).

trend_sma.mechanism: Hold while the total-return index is above its moving average, else cash (time-series trend following).

tsmom.mechanism: Hold while the trailing return beats bills, else cash (time-series momentum).

xs_momentum.mechanism: Each month hold the top funds by trailing return (cross-sectional momentum, optionally only those that beat bills).
xs_momentum.execution: market-on-close on the first session of the month

dual_momentum.mechanism: US stocks or international stocks by relative momentum, bonds when US stocks trail bills.
dual_momentum.execution: market-on-close on the first session of the month

rsi2.mechanism: Buy a short-term oversold fund (two-day RSI below a threshold), sell when it closes above its five-day mean (short-horizon reversal).

turn_of_month.mechanism: Hold over the last trading days of a month and the first days of the next (pension and payroll flows).

pre_holiday.mechanism: Hold the session before an exchange holiday.

vol_target.mechanism: Scale exposure to a volatility target from trailing realised volatility, capped at fully invested (volatility-managed portfolios).
vol_target.execution: market-on-close when the weight moves by more than the band

last_half_hour_momentum.mechanism: The return from the previous close to 15:30 predicts the last half hour (hedging and rebalancing flows into the close).
references: Baltussen, Da, Lammers and Martens (2021), JFE 142(1)
Gao, Han, Li and Zhou (2018), JFE 129(2)

first_hour_momentum.mechanism: The first hour's return predicts the last half hour.
references: Gao, Han, Li and Zhou (2018), JFE 129(2)
